title: Patient Encounter Skills (1B)
sourceNote: History coverage graded from the transcript. The case adds its SP physical exam checklist (peChecklist) and the post-encounter note key (penKey) at grading time. The pass threshold is a placeholder.

items.label: PMH: conditions
items.guidance: Asks about past medical conditions.

exemplars: Do you have any medical conditions?
What other health problems have you had in the past?
Has a doctor ever told you that you have diabetes or high blood pressure?
Tell me about your past medical history.
Are you being treated for any ongoing health conditions?
Have you been diagnosed with anything before, like heart or lung problems?
Any history of heart attacks, strokes, or kidney problems?
Do you see a doctor regularly for anything?
counterExemplars: Does anyone in your family have any medical conditions?
Have you ever had any surgeries?
What medications do you take?

items.label: PMH: when diagnosed
items.guidance: Asks when conditions were diagnosed.

keywords: how long ago were you diagnosed
how old were you when you were diagnosed
patterns: \b(?:what year|how long ago|how old were you when|at what age)\b.*\b(?:diagnos\w*|told you)\b

\bhow long have you (?:had|been living with|known about|been treated for|been diagnosed with) (?:diabetes|sugar|high blood pressure|blood pressure|hypertension|high cholesterol|cholesterol|heart failure|heart condition|heart problems?|weak heart|asthma|copd|emphysema|kidney (?:disease|problems?)|thyroid|that condition|these conditions|the condition|your condition|those conditions|that diagnosis|it diagnosed|them diagnosed|that diagnosed|this diagnosed)\b
\b(?:when|what year|how long ago) (?:did you have|was|were you told about) (?:your|the|that) (?:heart attack|stroke|mi|diagnosis)\b

\bwhen did (?:you|they) (?:find out|first find out|learn|discover)\b.*\b(?:diabetes|sugar|high blood pressure|blood pressure|hypertension|high cholesterol|cholesterol|heart failure|heart condition|heart problems?|weak heart|asthma|copd|emphysema|kidney (?:disease|problems?)|thyroid|that condition|these conditions|the condition|your condition|those conditions|that diagnosis|it diagnosed|them diagnosed|that diagnosed|this diagnosed)\b
exemplars: When were you diagnosed with that?
How long have you had high blood pressure?
What year was the heart attack?
How old were you when they told you about your heart?
When did you first find out you had a weak heart?
How long ago were you diagnosed with diabetes?
When was the heart failure first diagnosed?
counterExemplars: How long have you been short of breath?
When did the swelling start?
When was your last check-up?

items.label: PSH: surgeries / procedures
items.guidance: Asks about past surgeries or procedures.

patterns: \b(?:ever|been) (?:had |been )?(?:operated on|under the knife|put to sleep for)\b
exemplars: Have you ever had any surgeries?
Any operations or procedures in the past?
Have you had any heart procedures, like a stent?
Tell me about any surgeries you've had.
Have you ever been operated on?
Have you been in hospital for any procedures?
Any past surgical history I should know about?
counterExemplars: Do you have any medical conditions?
Is there any family history of heart disease?
Have you been admitted to hospital before for your breathing?

items.label: PSH: dates
items.guidance: Asks when surgeries/procedures happened.

keywords: when did you have the surgery
when did you have the operation
when did you have the procedure
when did you have the stent
patterns: \b(?:when|what year|how long ago) (?:was|were|did you have|did they (?:do|put in|place)|did you get) (?:the|that|your|those|these|it) ?(?:\w+ )?(?:surgery|surgeries|operation|operations|procedure|procedures|stent|stents|appendix|appendectomy|bypass|catheteri[sz]ation|angioplasty)\b

\bhow old were you when (?:you had|they (?:did|took out|removed)|you got) (?:the|that|your)?\s?(?:\w+ )?(?:surgery|surgeries|operation|operations|procedure|procedures|stent|stents|appendix|appendectomy|bypass|catheteri[sz]ation|angioplasty)?\b
exemplars: When was the stent put in?
What year did you have your appendix out?
How long ago was that operation?
When did you have the surgery?
How old were you when they took your appendix out?
And when was that procedure done?
What year was the heart procedure?
counterExemplars: When did the breathlessness start?
When were you diagnosed with high blood pressure?
When was your last doctor's appointment?

items.label: Medications: names
items.guidance: Asks what medications the patient takes.

exemplars: What medications do you take?
Are you on any regular medicines?
Can you tell me which pills you take every day?
Do you take any prescription medications?
What medicines has your doctor put you on?
Let's go over your medications.
Are you taking anything for your heart or blood pressure?
Do you have a list of your medications with you?
counterExemplars: Do you have any allergies to medications?
Do you take any vitamins or herbal supplements?
Do you use any recreational drugs?

items.label: Medications: doses
items.guidance: Asks about doses / how often taken.

exemplars: What dose of furosemide are you on?
How much of each medicine do you take?
How often do you take the carvedilol?
Is that once or twice a day?
Do you know how many milligrams that is?
How many times a day do you take your water pill?
What strength is your lisinopril?
counterExemplars: What medications do you take?
Have you been taking your pills as prescribed?
How much do you drink in a week?

items.label: Medications: over-the-counter and supplements
items.guidance: Asks specifically about OTC medicines, herbal products or supplements.

exemplars: Do you take any over-the-counter medicines?
Any vitamins or supplements?
Do you use any herbal remedies?
Anything you buy yourself at the pharmacy, like painkillers?
Have you been taking any ibuprofen or other anti-inflammatories?
Do you take anything without a prescription?
Any natural or home remedies?
counterExemplars: What prescription medications do you take?
Do you use any recreational drugs?
Have you been taking your medications as prescribed?

items.label: Allergies: drug
items.guidance: Asks about medication allergies.

exemplars: Do you have any allergies?
Are you allergic to any medications?
Any drug allergies?
Have you ever had a bad reaction to a medicine?
Are you allergic to penicillin or any antibiotics?
Do you have any allergies to medications or anything else?
Is there any medicine you can't take because of an allergy?
counterExemplars: Do you have any food allergies?
Do you get hay fever?
Have you had any side effects from your water pill?

items.label: Allergies: food
items.guidance: Asks about food allergies.

exemplars: Do you have any food allergies?
Are you allergic to any foods, like nuts or shellfish?
Any allergies to medicines or foods?
What about food: are you allergic to anything you eat?
Do any foods give you a reaction?
Any allergies to food, latex or anything in the environment?
counterExemplars: Do you have any allergies?
What do you usually eat in a day?
Have you been eating a lot of salty food?

items.label: Allergies: type of reaction
items.guidance: Asks what reaction occurred.

exemplars: What kind of reaction did you have?
What happened when you took penicillin?
What sort of reaction was it: a rash, or trouble breathing?
How did you react to it?
Did you get a rash or any swelling with that allergy?
What does it do to you?
Was it a mild reaction or a serious one?
counterExemplars: Do you have any allergies?
What happened when you ran out of your water pill?
Are you allergic to any foods?

items.label: FH: parents and siblings living / age and cause of death
items.guidance: Asks about the health of parents and siblings, and age/cause of death where applicable.

exemplars: Are your parents still alive?
Does anything run in your family, like heart disease or diabetes?
How old was your father when he passed away, and what did he die of?
Do you have any brothers or sisters, and are they healthy?
Is there any family history of heart problems or strokes?
What did your mother die from?
Are your siblings in good health?
Tell me about the health of your parents and siblings.
counterExemplars: Who do you live with?
How is your wife doing?
Do you have any children or grandchildren?

items.label: SH: alcohol
items.guidance: Asks about alcohol. For items marked "if relevant": score 1 if asked OR if clearly not relevant to this case and reasonably omitted; score 0 only if relevant and omitted.

exemplars: Do you drink alcohol?
How much do you drink in a typical week?
Do you have a beer or a glass of wine now and then?
How many drinks would you have on a usual day?
Have you ever had any problems with alcohol?
Do you drink at all?
What about alcohol: how often do you have a drink?
counterExemplars: How much water do you drink in a day?
Let me just clean my hands with some alcohol gel first.
Have you been drinking enough fluids?

items.label: SH: smoking / tobacco
items.guidance: Asks about smoking / tobacco. For items marked "if relevant": score 1 if asked OR if clearly not relevant to this case and reasonably omitted; score 0 only if relevant and omitted.

exemplars: Do you smoke?
Have you ever smoked cigarettes?
Do you use any tobacco products, like cigars or chewing tobacco?
How many packs a day did you smoke, and for how long?
Do you vape or use e-cigarettes?
When did you quit smoking?
Are you a smoker, or have you ever been one?
counterExemplars: Do you drink alcohol?
Do you use any recreational drugs?
Are you around a lot of smoke or fumes at work?

items.label: SH: recreational drugs
items.guidance: Asks about recreational drugs. For items marked "if relevant": score 1 if asked OR if clearly not relevant to this case and reasonably omitted; score 0 only if relevant and omitted.

exemplars: Do you use any recreational drugs?
Have you ever used marijuana, cocaine, or any other street drugs?
Do you take any drugs that weren't prescribed to you?
Have you ever injected drugs?
Any recreational substance use?
Do you use cannabis at all?
What about other drugs, like cocaine or opioids?
counterExemplars: What medications do you take?
Do you take any over-the-counter drugs?
Do you smoke cigarettes?

items.label: SH: occupation
items.guidance: Asks about occupation. For items marked "if relevant": score 1 if asked OR if clearly not relevant to this case and reasonably omitted; score 0 only if relevant and omitted.

keywords: what do you do for work
what do you do for a living
what did you do for work
what did you do for a living
patterns: \bwhat (?:do|did) you do (?:for (?:work|a living|a job)|before you retired)\b
exemplars: What do you do for work?
Are you working at the moment, or are you retired?
What did you do before you retired?
What kind of job do you have?
Where do you work?
What's your occupation?
Have you ever worked around dust or chemicals?
counterExemplars: How has this affected your work?
What do you like to do for fun?
Does anything help when you work out?

items.label: SH: who they live with
items.guidance: Asks about who they live with. For items marked "if relevant": score 1 if asked OR if clearly not relevant to this case and reasonably omitted; score 0 only if relevant and omitted.

patterns: \b(?:who|anyone|anybody) (?:do you live|lives|living|else lives|else is) (?:with|at home|with you)\b
\bwho (?:is|else is) (?:at home|there with you|home with you)\b
\b(?:is there|do you have) (?:anyone|someone|somebody) (?:at home|to help you|who can help)\b
exemplars: Who do you live with?
Do you live alone?
Is there anyone at home with you?
Tell me about your living situation.
Who's at home to help you if you need it?
Do you live with your wife?
What's your home set-up like: house, apartment, stairs?
counterExemplars: Where do you live?
How long have you lived in the city?
Is anyone in your family sick?

items.label: SH: what gives them joy / meaning
items.guidance: Asks about what gives them joy / meaning. For items marked "if relevant": score 1 if asked OR if clearly not relevant to this case and reasonably omitted; score 0 only if relevant and omitted.

keywords: what do you like to do
patterns: \bwhat (?:do you|things do you) (?:enjoy|like to do|love doing|do for fun|do in your (?:spare|free) time)\b
exemplars: What do you enjoy doing in your free time?
What gives you joy these days?
Do you have any hobbies?
What matters most to you in your life?
What keeps you going?
What do you like to do for fun?
Who or what is most important to you?
counterExemplars: What do you do for work?
What do you think is causing this?
What would you like to get out of today's visit?

items.label: SH: sexual history (if relevant)
items.guidance: Asks about sexual history (if relevant). For items marked "if relevant": score 1 if asked OR if clearly not relevant to this case and reasonably omitted; score 0 only if relevant and omitted.

exemplars: Are you sexually active?
How many sexual partners have you had in the last year?
Do you use protection, like condoms?
Have you noticed any changes in your sex life?
Is it okay if I ask a few questions about your sexual health?
Do you have sex with men, women, or both?
Any problems with erections?
counterExemplars: Are you married?
Who do you live with?
Do you have any children?

items.label: SH: travel (if relevant)
items.guidance: Asks about travel (if relevant). For items marked "if relevant": score 1 if asked OR if clearly not relevant to this case and reasonably omitted; score 0 only if relevant and omitted.

exemplars: Have you travelled anywhere recently?
Any long flights or car trips lately?
Have you been out of the country in the last few months?
Have you been away anywhere?
Any recent travel?
Have you been on a plane recently?
Did you go anywhere for the holidays?
counterExemplars: Does the pain travel anywhere?
How far can you walk?
Where do you live?

items.label: ROS: General
items.guidance: Asks at least one screening question for the General system (either during the HPI or in a review of systems).

patterns: ^(?!.*\b(?:let me know|tell me if|i(?:'|’| a)m going to (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine|test|shine|tap)|(?:i will|i(?:'|’)ll) (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine|test|shine|tap)|let me (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine|test|just|have a)|(?:i would|i(?:'|’)d) like to (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine|test)|i need to (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine))\b).*?\b(?:any|anything|have you|had you|has|have there been|has there been|do you|did you|does|are you|were you|is there|are there|was there|how is|how are|how has|how have|how often|what about|how about|ever|no)\b.*\b(?:fevers?|feverish|temperature|chills|rigors|night sweats|sweating at night|sweats|weight|kilos|pounds|tired\w*|fatigue\w*|exhausted|energy|run down|worn out)\b
exemplars: Have you had any fevers or chills?
Any night sweats?
Have you noticed any change in your weight?
Have you been feeling more tired than usual?
How is your energy level?
Have you lost or gained any weight recently?

Do you feel short of breath?
Are you feeling low in mood?

items.label: ROS: Skin
items.guidance: Asks at least one screening question for the Skin system (either during the HPI or in a review of systems).

patterns: ^(?!.*\b(?:let me know|tell me if|i(?:'|’| a)m going to (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine|test|shine|tap)|(?:i will|i(?:'|’)ll) (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine|test|shine|tap)|let me (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine|test|just|have a)|(?:i would|i(?:'|’)d) like to (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine|test)|i need to (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine))\b)(?!.*\b(?:penicillin|allerg\w*|reaction|antibiotic\w*)\b).*?\b(?:any|anything|have you|had you|has|have there been|has there been|do you|did you|does|are you|were you|is there|are there|was there|how is|how are|how has|how have|how often|what about|how about|ever|no)\b.*\b(?:rash\w*|skin|itch\w*|bruis\w*|sores|ulcers?|wounds?|moles?|lumps?|discolou?r\w*|hives|blisters?)\b
exemplars: Any rashes?
Have you noticed any changes in your skin?
Any itching?
Do you bruise easily?
Any sores or wounds that won't heal?
Have you noticed any new moles or lumps?
Has the skin on your legs changed colour?
counterExemplars: Did you get a rash from penicillin?
Any swelling in your ankles?
I'm going to take a look at the skin on your legs now.

items.label: ROS: Endocrine
items.guidance: Asks at least one screening question for the Endocrine system (either during the HPI or in a review of systems).

patterns: ^(?!.*\b(?:let me know|tell me if|i(?:'|’| a)m going to (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine|test|shine|tap)|(?:i will|i(?:'|’)ll) (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine|test|shine|tap)|let me (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine|test|just|have a)|(?:i would|i(?:'|’)d) like to (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine|test)|i need to (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine))\b).*?\b(?:any|anything|have you|had you|has|have there been|has there been|do you|did you|does|are you|were you|is there|are there|was there|how is|how are|how has|how have|how often|what about|how about|ever|no)\b.*\b(?:thirst\w*|heat intolerance|cold intolerance|(?:too|very|always|more) (?:hot|cold)|(?:the )?(?:heat|cold) (?:bother|bothers|bothered)|feel(?:ing)? (?:hot|cold) when|thyroid|blood sugars?|sugar levels?|glucose|sweat\w* (?:more|a lot)|drinking (?:a lot )?more (?:water|fluids)|hair (?:loss|thinning|changes))\b
exemplars: Have you been more thirsty than usual?
Do you feel too hot or too cold when others are comfortable?
Any problems with your thyroid?
Have your blood sugars been high?
Have you been sweating more than usual?
Does the heat or cold bother you more than it used to?
Are you drinking a lot more water than before?
counterExemplars: Do you have diabetes in your family?
Have you had any fevers?
How much alcohol do you drink?

items.label: ROS: Psychiatric
items.guidance: Asks at least one screening question for the Psychiatric system (either during the HPI or in a review of systems).

patterns: ^(?!.*\b(?:let me know|tell me if|i(?:'|’| a)m going to (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine|test|shine|tap)|(?:i will|i(?:'|’)ll) (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine|test|shine|tap)|let me (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine|test|just|have a)|(?:i would|i(?:'|’)d) like to (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine|test)|i need to (?:look|listen|check|feel|press|examine))\b)(?!.*\b(?:pillows|flat|breath\w*|gasping|propped|recliner|wake up short)\b).*?\b(?:any|anything|have you|had you|has|have there been|has there been|do you|did you|does|are you|were you|is there|are there|was there|how is|how are|how has|how have|how often|what about|how about|ever|no)\b.*\b(?:mood|depress\w*|anxi\w*|nervous|panic|stress\w*|feeling (?:down|low|blue|hopeless|sad)|lost (?:interest|pleasure)|harm\w* yourself|hurt\w* yourself|suicid\w*|sleeping|sleep)\b
exemplars: How has your mood been lately?
Have you been feeling down or depressed?
Do you feel anxious or stressed a lot?
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
How have you been sleeping?
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself?
Has anything been causing you a lot of stress?
counterExemplars: How many pillows do you sleep on?
Do you wake up at night short of breath?
Are you worried about what's causing this?
